keyLimits.en: 5 seats included, 15,000 models/month, 5,000 queried metrics/month, 1 project. Billed monthly by credit card.
100,000 models/month, 20,000 metrics/month, up to 30 projects, SSO and role-based access control.
Unlimited projects, column-level lineage, multi-project dbt Mesh, PrivateLink and IP restrictions.

cautions.en: Usage caps (models run/month, metrics queried/month) can force an upgrade even for a single small team if pipelines run frequently.

capabilities.en: SQL-based data transformation with version-controlled, testable data models.
Browser-based IDE with git safeguards, job scheduling, and monitoring.
dbt Semantic Layer for querying shared business metrics (Starter and above).
GitHub/GitLab CI integration for automated pipeline testing.

limitations.en: Free Developer plan is capped at 1 seat and 3,000 model runs/month, unsuitable for a team.
Column-level lineage and multi-project architecture (dbt Mesh) require Enterprise+.
SSO and role-based access control are Enterprise-tier only, not available on Starter.

reason.en: Often paired with or substituted by warehouse-native transformation, overlapping on the analytics-pipeline job.
Adjacent data-pipeline tool sometimes used to replace parts of a dbt-based workflow.

unknowns: Whether the free Developer/dbt Core plan is offered as hosted (dbt Cloud) or only as the open-source dbt Core CLI is not fully disentangled from the pricing page alone.
